blocks.text: DAVAO CITY — The Philippine Eagle Foundation (PEF) has released necropsy results of Philippine Eagle “Salay,” which was found dead near an electrical post in Barangay Guinalaban, Salay, Misamis Oriental, on Oct.1. An examination revealed that the female eagle, estimated to be around five years old, had no external injuries, aside from burn marks on her left foot pad and green-purple discoloration over her abdominal region. In her report, Dr. Danielle Kirsten Pasion, PEF veterinarian, said the eagle’s heart appeared enlarged with blood accumulated within the pericardial sac.
